product_wide_rationale: Successor of the record that defines the Domain model itself. It carries what a Domain is and how law homes to one, so no partition it creates can own it.
summary: Carries architecture-bound Product law forward as Concord's primary coordination model: canonical Domains own law, Product-changing work binds its architecture footprint, and concurrent work on the same Domain reconciles through Git rather than a blocking overlap. Code ownership follows package boundaries; global navigation, generated cards, forced participation, and navigation adoption are retired with their consumers. Storage authority, research-pack authority, breaking cutovers, the surviving store query bounds and authority, and the applicable refinements (CD-0042 sequencing, CD-0144 execution-start fact, the 2026-09-22 browse correction, CD-0213 planning placement) remain in force. A declared, checked package-to-Domain map feeds the footprint read.
title: Architecture-bound Product law with package-boundary code ownership
